properties.Description: The properties of the Private Traffic Manager profile.

location.Description: The geo-location where the resource lives

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

customTopologyMapMode.Description: The mode for custom topology map of the Private Traffic Manager profile.

dnsConfig.Description: The DNS related configuration properties of the Private Traffic Manager

topologyMapId.Description: The ARM resource ID of the topology map associated with this Private Traffic Manager profile.

profileStatus.Description: The status of the Private Traffic Manager profile.

trafficRoutingMethod.Description: The traffic routing method of the Private Traffic Manager profile.

endpoints.Description: The list of endpoints in the Private Traffic Manager profile.

recordType.Description: The record type of the Traffic Manager profile.

ttl.Description: The TTL of the DNS records in seconds.

target.Description: The fully-qualified DNS name or IP address of the endpoint. Traffic Manager returns this value in DNS responses to direct traffic to this endpoint.

monitoringTarget.Description: Monitoring target is where Private Traffic Manager will gather health information.It can differ from the endpoint target, for example when the target is an IPv6 address. If not configured, the endpoint target is used. It is required when the target is IPv6 and cannot itself be an IPv6 address.

endpointStatus.Description: The status of the endpoint. If the endpoint is Enabled, it is probed for endpoint health and is included in the traffic routing method.

kind.Description: Metadata used by portal/tooling/etc to render different UX experiences for resources of the same type; e.g. ApiApps are a kind of Microsoft.Web/sites type.  If supported, the resource provider must validate and persist this value.

weight.Description: The weight of this endpoint when using the 'Weighted' traffic routing method. Possible values are from 1 to 1000.

priority.Description: The priority of this endpoint when using the 'Priority' traffic routing method. Possible values are from 1 to 1000, lower values represent higher priority. This is an optional parameter.  If specified, it must be specified on all endpoints, and no two endpoints can share the same priority value.

alwaysServe.Description: Indicates whether endpoint is Always Serve or not. Always Serve endpoints are always considered to be healthy.

healthPolicyId.Description: The health policy associated with this endpoint.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)

properties.Description: The properties of the Topology Map.

location.Description: The geo-location where the resource lives

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

sites.Description: The list of Sites in the Topology Map.

catchAllSiteName.Description: The Name of the CatchAll site. There is only one CatchAll site in a TopologyMap

provisioningState.Description: The provisioning state of the TopologyMap resource.

probingGatewayIds.Description: The ARM resource ID of the probing gateway that can be used to monitor health as surrogate to the networks in the Site.

virtualNetworkIds.Description: The list of Network IDs that forms the Site.

systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

probeConfig.Description: Probe monitoring settings of the Traffic Manager profile. Only applicable when the parent health policy `kind` is `Probe`.

protocol.Description: The protocol (HTTP, HTTPS or TCP) used to probe for endpoint health.

port.Description: The TCP port used to probe for endpoint health.

path.Description: The path relative to the endpoint domain name used to probe for endpoint health.

intervalInSeconds.Description: The monitor interval for endpoints in this profile. This is the interval at which Traffic Manager will check the health of each endpoint in this profile. Allowed values: 10 or 30 seconds.

timeoutInSeconds.Description: The monitor timeout for endpoints in this profile. This is the time that Traffic Manager allows endpoints in this profile to response to the health check.

toleratedNumberOfFailures.Description: The number of consecutive failed health check that Traffic Manager tolerates before declaring an endpoint in this profile Degraded after the next failed health check.

expectedStatusCodeRanges.Description: List of expected status code ranges.
